title: ColdChainSensorTelemetry
description: Validation schema for industrial cold-chain sensor payload ingested by the Webhook Oracle.

event_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier for the telemetry event.

reading_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp of the reading.

temperature_c.description: Temperature in Celsius. Must be within cold-chain safe bounds (-25C to 15C).

sensor_status.description: Operational health status of the transmitting sensor.
